name: Eclipse -Shingetsukan no Musume-
original_name: エクリプス -新月館の娘-
source:
Main character just graduated from the university and went to work to a flower shop. While delivering a flower bouquet to one very rich household he's requested by the owner to teach his daughter Yuka sex in order for her to become a skillful spy.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vn-of-month-june-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角刚从大学毕业，在花店打工。一次，他向一户非常富有的人家送花，户主却要求他教自己的女儿由香性知识，让她成为一名优秀的间谍。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vn-of-month-june-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
